equity.level_reason: Respondents are health care providers compared by provider type, region, years in practice and caseload, none of which is a social-position dimension; access barriers are mentioned only in passing in the discussion.

level_alternative.reason: The discussion notes a disadvantage for patients who face challenges seeking care or lack access to specialists, which could be read as equity raised generically.

notes: Design inferred as cross-sectional from a one-time panel survey. Table 2 also gives mean (SD) knowledge scores, but claims rest on percentages; Table 1 CIs carry no conclusions. Outcome is provider knowledge, not disease frequency.
view_issues: Table 1 CI for 'Not too confident' (32.9–33.7) does not contain 35.3%; the AGS-diagnosed rows list >5 alongside 6–19, 20–100 and >100 (overlapping categories).
